title: StealTok: 130k Users Compromised by Data Stealing TikTok Video “Downloaders”
content: LayerX security researchers have uncovered a campaign of at least 12 interrelated browser extensions that masquerade as TikTok video downloaders but in reality track user activity and collect data. The extensions share a common codebase and are all clones or lightly modified versions of each other, indicating that this is a long-standing and persistent.
